## Projects

### Education Platform (2025 – Present)
A full-stack education web application built with React.js and Django.
Integrated with Cloudinary for media management and Neon (serverless Postgres) for the database.
Deployed on Render. Features include course management, user authentication, and media upload.
Status: Near production-ready.

### OCR Mobile App (2025 – Present)
A cross-platform mobile application for iOS and Android.
Uses Supabase as the backend and a custom OCR pipeline for extracting text from images.
Currently collecting training data to fine-tune a custom OCR model post-launch.
Status: Near production-ready.

### Interactive Web Applications (2023 – 2024)
